fs.write:
#!/bin/sh
root="$fixture"
tag=$$1
shift
out="action:$$tag:$$STRATA_ACTION_SOURCE"
for p in "$$@"; do
  rel=$${p#"$$root"}
  out="$$out:$${rel:-/}"
done
printf "%s\n" "$$out" >> "$$root/.launched"

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Primary Viewer
Exec=$environment/record-open primary %U
MimeType=text/plain;text/markdown;inode/directory;

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Secondary Viewer
Exec=$environment/record-open secondary %U
MimeType=text/plain;text/markdown;text/csv;inode/directory;

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Other Viewer
Exec=$environment/record-open other %U
MimeType=application/octet-stream;

schema_version = 1
id = "alpha-record"
name = "Alpha record"
menu = "top"
[when]
extensions = ["txt", "md"]
[run]
runtime = "command"
program = "$environment/record-action"
args = ["alpha", "{paths}"]

schema_version = 1
id = "beta-confirm"
name = "Beta confirm"
menu = "submenu"
[when]
[run]
runtime = "command"
program = "$environment/record-action"
confirm = true
args = ["beta", "{paths}"]

schema_version = 1
id = "gamma-folder"
name = "Gamma folder"
menu = "submenu"
[when]
kinds = ["folder"]
[run]
runtime = "command"
program = "$environment/record-action"
args = ["gamma", "{paths}"]
